I3 judgement: the registered data dictionary says a condition stated only in words ('room temperature') is not a number and is not imputed (temperature_unstated), so no uptake value has a stated or recoverable temperature, giving no_conditions_stated, which precedes no_surface_area in the table order. If a resolver accepts 'room temperature' as a stated temperature, I3 is met and the code becomes no_surface_area (I4 fails independently). Not retracted (record is_retracted false); not a review; no statement that the uptake values were published before.
